data.one_liner: Use whisper.cpp speech-to-text models implementation for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides an implementation of whisper.cpp models for speech-to-text transcription and translation on Android, iOS, and macOS. Supports multiple model sizes from tiny to large, allowing offline audio processing.
use_when: You need on-device speech-to-text transcription for audio files
You want to run whisper.cpp models within a Flutter application on Android, iOS, or macOS
avoid_when: You require cloud-based speech recognition services with streaming real-time mic input not supported by this API
You are targeting platforms other than Android, iOS, and macOS
strengths: Supports multiple whisper.cpp model sizes (tiny, base, small, medium, large)
Optimized and fast native implementations for mobile and desktop platforms
weaknesses: Requires managing model files and downloads
Limited platform support (Android, iOS, macOS only)
data.setup_notes: Requires supplying audio files in WAV format and downloading whisper.cpp model files.
